description: Omeify canonical collection-root attributes for NGFF 0.5 / Zarr v3. Child images have the single-image profile; OME/ has a separate ordered manifest. This is not a whole-store or deidentification validator.

provenance.description: Deliberate caller-supplied finite JSON, not copied source metadata or privacy-reviewed text. String keys, depth and a 1 MiB encoded-size bound are checked in Python.
